description: Look up balance, account mode and open positions for up to 1,000 wallets (100 when includeHip3=true), sorted by balance. Handles unified-account and portfolio-margin wallets, whose money sits in spot rather than perps. Use for watchlists: "which of these wallets are whales?", "what do these 50 traders hold?".

items.description: Wallet address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

includeHip3.description: Include HIP-3 markets (limit drops to 100 wallets).

minBalanceUsd.description: Only return wallets with at least this balance (see balanceNote on each wallet).

name: hydromancer_compare_wallets
title: Compare many wallets at once
